method: Official unencrypted public package; GDRETools v2.7.4 script inspection. Original source remains outside project in temporary analysis directory; this artifact records mechanics only. Native UnitPhysics implementation not recovered.

facts.eligible: can_charge resource flag; cooldown must expire
facts.destination: selected eligible centroid; cap direction length at 760; keep each eligible position offset
facts.acceleration: per-axis move_toward at fallback 1200 units/s²; UnitStats class has no acceleration field
facts.contact: enemy feet within weapon attack range
facts.mounted_slow: each distinct victim adds 0.12 to penalty, capped at 0.65
facts.mounted_hit_ledger: each victim at most once per charge
facts.infantry: first hit changes to pursuing and starts cooldown
facts.mounted: continues toward ground goal, ends within 25 units, duration expiry or speed below10 after0.15s
facts.knockback: 260 * speed_fraction; mounted ×3; radial direction rotated outward by random0.1..0.45 radians according to side of velocity
facts.cooldown: unit resource8s cavalry,10s swordsman/veteran/spearman; command cancellation consumes cooldown
facts.shield_wall: incoming direction dot facing >0.34; melee damage ×0.4, ranged ×0.2
facts.pikes: no special anti-charge stop found in inspected charge path; normal spear combat rules separate
facts.starting_velocity: charge command keeps previous velocity; accelerates from current movement, not forced zero

implementation_differences_remaining: Native impulse decay and crowd repulsion not measured; local decay8/s and existing terrain clearance are provisional.
Deterministic outward scatter replaces nondeterministic random angle for regression reproducibility.
Original allows charge command to reset an ongoing run while cooldown zero; local input rejects restarting an active charge.
Current C adopts explicit per-soldier rules; untouched autonomous cavalry still use legacy automatic regiment charge.
Normal attack animation timing, ranged flight, auto-AI and battle morale still not fully matched.
Game uses existing64x64pixelart, not original procedural limb system.
This old public version does not prove current Steam-version equivalence.

native_physics_followup.collision_change: Hard-circle blocking replaced by public soft pair response; single-rank shield/pike clips no longer demonstrate guaranteed stopping
